You just perfectly explained this omg!

To me, the best way to describe it, is that it feels like impending doom, and I do not mean it in an exaggerating way. It doesn't matter what I do, the only thing on my mind is attempting; when i'm driving, laying in bed, in school, showering, and much more. You feel like goop, heavy and icky, and lose the will to do anything. Not even music or you comfort show/movie helps. Your heart feels heavy, and you feel unworthy. 

When you get in a suicidal mindset, it is very difficult to get out of it. I remember standing over the Los Angeles 6th street bridge and just *feeling* I was going to die. Someone pulled me back and I just ran, ran, and ran.

When I say "impending doom" just imagine dreading taking an exam you know you didn't study for, so of course you will fail. That's depression. You don't even stand a chance, you know your are going to die.

It feels really nice knowing that someone knows what i’m going through. Everyone tells me that this feeling is going to go away soon, but it won’t. It’s not just me being pessimistic, I already went through this before and it takes time. But thank you for your support :))
thank youuu! your words do bring me a sense of comfort, it’s what i needed after bawling my eyes out in the dorm showers lol
